releaseNotes:
## AgentOS 2.0.0-beta.19

- Fixed online, offline, install, and repair completion messages so the shown AgentOS URL uses the configured host and port instead of always displaying `http://127.0.0.1:4174`
- Kept AgentOS Runtime `1.0.0-beta.5` unchanged because this release changes only the Core installer and its regression coverage

### Verification

- Passed the complete 309-test TypeScript, Server, UI, and TypeScript SDK suite after a production build
- Passed focused bootstrap-installer regression coverage for the resolved health URL and configured public URL
- Verified the installer completion message on Linux with a non-default port reports the same URL that its successful health check used
